name: see-veo
title: Personal CV / Resume
description: Personal CV and resume as an installable Progressive Web App with PDF export.
audience: The developer/owner — this is a personal CV site. Visitors are potential employers, clients, and collaborators.
useCases: Showcase skills, projects, and activity to potential employers
Download CV as PDF via browser print dialog
Install as a PWA for quick offline access
View commit activity charts embedded from repo-tor

dataPrivacy.storage: Static site with no user data collection.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Embeds repo-tor charts via iframe. Contact form sends to tool-till-tees API.
